verdict.rationale: The Gusto CLI's documented authentication/telemetry section explicitly states that API requests carry anonymous usage headers (X-Gusto-CLI-Install-Id, X-Gusto-CLI-Command) and that setting GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 omits both, providing a documented, environment-variable-based opt-out mechanism for an AI-native (agent-facing) tool. This is first-party documented and specific, but missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the opt-out actually suppresses telemetry, and confirmation that the same opt-out extends to other Gusto surfaces (e.g., the MCP server or web dashboard) beyond the CLI.
